CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present (A absent).

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinate) and organization/origin are both explicitly listed for the same referent/time, and origin separates identification from status.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to a content's organization or access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify items (red/blue) with coordinate values.

D.rationale: The report lists content coordinates and separately lists an origin/status entry for the same referent, distinguishing identification from status/presentation.

O.rationale: The text specifies presentation layout and per-referent origin/representation metadata describing how contents are organized/accessed.
